summary: Tower Semiconductor filed a Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K) disclosing a press release, not a transaction. The release confirms continued collaboration with Innolight on Near-Package Optics for AI infrastructure, noting Innolight's first NPO device entered early production on Tower's PH18M silicon photonics process at its California fab and that multiple NPO products were taped out on Tower's 300mm platform. No stake, price, board recommendation, advisor, or deal structure is stated. This is an ordinary commercial/technology update, so there is no deal terms or risk-arb angle.
